prompt:
A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult woman — the personification of the element Lithium (리튬) itself — the sovereign of the Lithium Nation. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.

1. STYLE
A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance.
Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline. Her eyes keep the shape and size described below.

2. CHARACTER
Age: late twenties — a graceful grown-up face with soft, smooth contours; no wrinkles, folds or under-eye bags.
Face — her own: a sharp, striking, intense look; fair skin; oval face; medium-sized eyes — narrow upturned eyes, outer eye corners slightly lifted; sharp angled brows; straight narrow nose; thin long lips; crimson eyes; a thin faint scar through one eyebrow.
Body and hair: lean and long-legged, with a natural neck length build; a long ponytail with center-parted bangs framing the face; soft silver-white hair tipped with crimson flame-red.
Expression: a firm, resolute look with calm, steady eyes.
Her element, carried in her design: lithium: the lightest metal of all, so soft it cuts with a knife and so light it floats on oil; a fresh cut shines silver-white, then dulls to dark grey in open air; it burns with a vivid crimson flame; it stores and releases power inside every rechargeable battery; found in 1817 in a pale stone called petalite and named for stone; drawn from turquoise brine ponds on high salt flats; a medicine that calms a restless mind.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME — MECHA
Costume: she is a female mecha personification — plates, joints, binders and glow lines carry the traits above; the plates must read as solid armor with visible joints, not as cloth or a gown; a back unit may carry the motif. light soft-silver armor with crimson charge-bar stripes that fill and glow along the limbs, freshly cut bright silver edges over tarnished charcoal-grey panels, six small battery-cell shield units floating symmetrically around her, each with a glowing crimson charge indicator; the plates must read as solid armor, not a gown.
Silhouette: light body armor with several small shield and drone units floating symmetrically around her. Only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely in the element's materials and palette.
Colours: soft silver-white, vivid crimson flame red, tarnished charcoal grey, pale petalite pink.
Exposure (bold): her mecha frame is cut open by design in only these places — bare shoulders and upper arms between pauldron and gauntlet, and a deep open chest window with natural cleavage framed by the chest plates; everywhere else she stays fully plated. The plates stay on, fitted and symmetrical, with skin clearly showing in each opening. Nothing slipped off. Intimate areas covered; keep the plate material and palette.

4. SCENE
World: year 2200, the charge capital: a city built as one vast battery on a high desert plateau, stacked cell towers banded with charge bars filling from crimson to white, power stored by night and released by day, terraced evaporation ponds of turquoise lithium brine stretching below.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Light: the scene's own light, rendered the way this style renders light and skin.
Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (Li) and atomic number (3) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.
Avoid: flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face, plastic 3D-render finish.
